scope: Corrections to derived evidence only. No raw forensic record was modified.

corrections.cause: The deriving probe compared the raw outcome with an exact equality: thrPre.rows.filter((r) => r.outcome === 'THROW').length. The raw rows record the outcome as 'THROW RangeError', so the predicate matched nothing and the summary claimed 0 pre-fix throws even though 8 of the 10 budget rows threw.
corrections.derivation: count of _raw/stack_threshold_pre.json rows whose outcome string starts with 'THROW' = 8 (1500, 2000, 2500, 3000, 4000, 6000, 20000, 100000). The two COMPLETED rows are 500 and 1000.

derivingProbeFixed.note: Fixed so a future re-run of the assembler cannot reproduce the wrong count. The evidence file itself was corrected by an explicit, auditable write, not by re-running the assembler (a re-run would have needed the full regression log to regenerate sibling artifacts).
